goal: Create the additive connectivity-stack schema that future CarrierConfig, eSIM RSP, IMS, registration, firmware and failure-diagnosis phases can share.
evidence_boundaries: Profile install/enable does not prove network registration.
Network registration does not prove mobile data.
Mobile data does not prove IMS or VoLTE.
Generic carrier voice/SMS listings are not split into directional sub-results unless the source does so.
Subscriber secrets are prohibited from storage.
official_basis: Android carrier customization / CarrierConfig and carrier identification
Android IMS service entitlement and provisioning
GSMA consumer eSIM remote SIM provisioning specification family
next_phase: Phase155 CarrierConfig / Carrier Settings normalization on top of the Phase154 schema.
